meta.title: 99 Nights in the Forest tameable animals data

sources.label: 99 Nights in the Forest Wiki - Tamed animals

excludedRows.name: Chick
excludedRows.reason: Source-backed as tameable with Old Flute and 1 Carrot, but tied to Easter/chick egg behavior. Excluded from normal progression until parent approves a limited/event reference row.

excludedRows.name: Corrupted Wolf
excludedRows.reason: Hard Mode variant with same useful taming requirements as Wolf. Kept as a note on Wolf by parent default instead of a separate card.

excludedRows.name: Corrupted Alpha Wolf
excludedRows.reason: Hard Mode variant with same useful taming requirements as Alpha Wolf. Kept as a note on Alpha Wolf by parent default instead of a separate card.

notes: This dataset is for the Taming Flute loop, not a pet or egg economy.
Food totals use source-backed total amounts where available. Per-stage food is included because players must feed after each successful minigame stage.
Boar total food is calculated from the page text: one Morsel and one Corn after each successful minigame, repeated two times.
Mossy Mammoth image was resolved through the Fandom File:Mossy_Mammoth.png imageinfo endpoint after article parse returned no images.

items.name: Bunny
items.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame once and feed 1 Carrot.
items.steps: Complete 1 taming minigame, then feed 1 Carrot.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest level 0-3 campfire, plus Farm and Bunny Burrow spawns.
items.benefit: Lowest-cost tame and the safest early way to practice the minigame.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Runs away when damaged or approached; keep other tamed animals from hitting it while taming.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Bunny page and PC Gamer agree on Old Flute and 1 Carrot.

items.name: Kiwi
items.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame once and feed 1 Berry.
items.steps: Complete 1 taming minigame, then feed 1 Berry.
items.location: Kiwi Burrow near Campfire Level 6 areas
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Campfire Level 6 - Kiwi Burrow; PC Gamer describes Kiwi as rare and not available in every match.
items.benefit: A low-food tame that is mainly valuable because it is rare and helps with taming completion/XP goals.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Rare spawn; do not plan a run around finding it unless the burrow appears.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Kiwi page lists Berry x1 and Campfire Level 6 Kiwi Burrow.

items.name: Green Frog
items.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame twice and feed 1 Mackerel after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 2 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Mackerel.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest and Jungle Biome, with ponds and Frog Cave as locations. Older source copy ties frogs to pond emergence after a run timer.
items.benefit: An Old Flute tame tied to pond/frog routing, useful when the run gives frog access.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Frogs can poison players and may not appear in every run.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Frogs page and PC Gamer agree on Old Flute and 2 Mackerel total.

items.name: Scorpion
items.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame twice and feed 1 Steak plus 1 Morsel after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 2 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak and 1 Morsel.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Volcanic Biome level 2+ campfire, with Scorpion Nest and Scorpion Pit locations.
items.benefit: A stronger Old Flute target for volcanic routes once the player can handle poison risk.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Hostile and poison-capable; clear nearby threats before starting the minigame.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Scorpion page lists Steak x2 and Morsel x2; PC Gamer agrees on the total.

items.name: Wolf
items.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame three times and feed 1 Steak plus 1 Morsel after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 3 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak and 1 Morsel.
items.location: The Forest, night biomes, Locked Cave #1, Large Cabin
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest level 2+ campfire and any other biome at night. Guard and night-spawned variants need caution.
items.benefit: The first practical combat-style tame most players can plan around with Old Flute.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Chosen wolf must not have taken damage; guard/night-spawned variants can be unsuitable or untameable.
items.availability: Normal, with Hard Mode variant note
variantNotes: Corrupted Wolf is a Hard Mode/Rift variant with the same Old Flute, 3-stage, Steak x3 and Morsel x3 requirement. Parent direction keeps it as a note, not a separate row.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Wolf page verifies Old Flute, 3 hearts, Steak x3, Morsel x3, and the no-damage taming caveat.

items.name: Boar
items.food: Morsel x2 total, Corn x2 total
items.tamingRequirement: Old Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame two times and feed 1 Morsel plus 1 Corn after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 2 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Morsel and 1 Corn.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Jungle Biome and no specific locations.
items.benefit: A newer Old Flute target for Jungle routes, useful if players need a tame while exploring that biome.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Hostile Jungle animal with incomplete source stats; tame only if it has not taken damage.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Boar page verifies Old Flute, 2 hearts, Jungle Biome, and 1 Morsel plus 1 Corn after each successful minigame. The text says the process repeats two times, so total food is calculated as 2 Morsels and 2 Corn.
items.verificationNote: Total food is calculated from the source text: 1 Morsel and 1 Corn after each successful minigame, repeated two times.

items.name: Arctic Fox
items.tamingRequirement: Good Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame three times and feed 1 Steak plus 1 Chili after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 3 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak and 1 Chili.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Snow Biome level 2+ campfire and says it can spawn alone or in groups.
items.benefit: A Good Flute target for snow routes, with lower listed damage than Alpha Wolf but easier biome identity.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Often appears in packs, so clear or separate nearby foxes before taming.
items.sourceNote: Fandom uses Arctic Fox; PC Gamer uses Snow Fox. Use Arctic Fox as canonical and Snow Fox as alias.

items.name: Alpha Wolf
items.food: Steak x4, Mackerel x4, Salmon x4
items.tamingRequirement: Good Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame four times and feed 1 Steak, 1 Mackerel, and 1 Salmon after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 4 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak, 1 Mackerel, and 1 Salmon.
items.location: The Forest, night biomes, Locked Cave #2, Cultist Hunter Camp
items.biome: The Forest; any biome at night
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists The Forest level 3+ campfire and any other biome at level 3+ campfire during night.
items.benefit: A stronger wolf-style tame with higher listed HP, damage, speed, and detection range than Wolf.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Needs fish plus steak over four stages; night-spawned alpha wolves can be unsuitable or untameable.
items.availability: Normal, with Hard Mode variant note
variantNotes: Corrupted Alpha Wolf is a Hard Mode/Rift variant with the same Good Flute, 4-stage, Steak x4, Mackerel x4, and Salmon x4 requirement. Parent direction keeps it as a note, not a separate row.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Alpha Wolf page verifies Good Flute, 4 stages, current fish/steak food set, spawn notes, and night-spawn caveat.

items.name: Bear
items.food: Steak x5, Pumpkin x5, Salmon x5
items.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 1 Steak, 1 Pumpkin, and 1 Salmon after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Steak, 1 Pumpkin, and 1 Salmon.
items.location: The Forest level 5-6, Cultist Hunter Camp, Locked Caves
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Forest level 5 and 6 campfire, plus Cultist Hunter Camp and Locked Caves.
items.benefit: A high-HP, high-damage forest tame for players who have upgraded past Good Flute.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit. Zookeeper class at max level may reduce repeats per Fandom note.
items.risk: Expensive five-stage tame; prepare all food before starting.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Bear page verifies Strong Flute, 5 stages, Steak/Pumpkin/Salmon, and class caveat.

items.name: Polar Bear
items.food: Rib x5, Stew x5, Swordfish x5
items.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 1 Rib, 1 Stew, and 1 Swordfish after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 1 Rib, 1 Stew, and 1 Swordfish.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Snow Biome and Polar Bear Cave; older Forest/Snowy Patch locations are marked formerly.
items.benefit: A high-damage Strong Flute target for snow routing.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: One of the most expensive rows because it needs fish plus cooked food over five stages.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Polar Bear page and PC Gamer support 5 each of Rib, Stew, and Swordfish. The Fandom Taming Flute table appears malformed for this row.
items.verificationNote: Uses the individual Polar Bear page and PC Gamer for Rib, Stew, and Swordfish because the central Taming Flute table appears malformed.

items.name: Mammoth
items.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 2 Pumpkins and 1 Cake.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Snow Biome; PC Gamer also lists Snow.
items.benefit: A very tanky Strong Flute target with knockback behavior once provoked.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Requires a large pumpkin and cake stockpile; neutral until attacked, so do not let pets start the fight while setting up.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Mammoth page and PC Gamer agree on Pumpkin x10 and Cake x5.

items.name: Hellephant
items.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 2 Pumpkins and 1 Cake.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Volcanic Biome and Hellephant Ritual Circle, guarded by cultists.
items.benefit: A mammoth-style Strong Flute target for Volcanic Biome routes.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: Guarded volcanic route and expensive five-stage pumpkin/cake requirement.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Hellephant page and PC Gamer agree on Pumpkin x10 and Cake x5. Image source filename uses Lava Mammoth.

items.name: Mossy Mammoth
items.tamingRequirement: Strong Taming Flute or better; complete the minigame five times and feed 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake after each success.
items.steps: Repeat 5 times: complete the taming minigame, then feed 2 Pumpkins and 1 Cake.
items.spawnNotes: Fandom lists Jungle Biome level 4+ campfire.
items.benefit: A Jungle variant of the mammoth-style Strong Flute target with the same pumpkin/cake planning burden.
items.limit: Counts toward the normal tamed-animal limit.
items.risk: High-food Strong Flute target in the Jungle Biome; source text is typo-heavy, so keep copy tied to the verified flute, food, stage, HP, damage, and biome facts.
items.sourceNote: Fandom Mossy Mammoth page verifies Jungle Biome, Strong Flute, five repeats, 2 Pumpkins plus 1 Cake per repeat, and total 10 Pumpkins/5 Cakes.
